historical_reference.omitted_diagnostics: Eight historical endpoint clips are omitted; final twenty cases and per-round sentinels match.
algorithm_differences: Different objectives, advantage transformations, learning rates, clipping, replay counts and optimizer-step budgets.
New objectives average Gaussian coordinates; historical RLOO sums them.
Flash uses one uniformly sampled replay action from a common four-noise-action trajectory; this is a matched-sampler adaptation.
AWM/NFT train on forward-noised fresh endpoints with saved pre-action semantic states; these are not on-trajectory replay states.
NFT retains its collection-policy EMA; final evaluation uses the current policy.
The historical evaluation scenes have already been inspected; this is not an unseen confirmation panel.

provenance.note: Intentional exact reuse of the ten-round campaign prompts/seeds for historical comparison. No RLOO retraining. Tracking persistence is not geometry accuracy.

The scene contains a parked car, a pedestrian walking on the pavement and a bicycle near a fence. Buildings, green trees, a paved road and a sidewalk are clearly visible under an open daytime sky. The camera advances in one continuous shot with natural walking motion. Nearby objects grow with perspective, distant objects remain coherent, and partial occlusion happens naturally. Vehicles preserve their shapes as the viewer approaches. No cuts, no transitions, realistic everyday street scene.
